$comment: Declarative manifest for www.tdpdf.com. build/ghost/publish-site.ps1 reads this and
nothing else decides what the site contains.
'source' is relative to this file. A source that points OUTSIDE build/ghost/ is a
repository document being published verbatim: it is read at publish time, every time,
so the page cannot drift from the file the application actually ships. Do not
'fix' such a page by editing it in the Ghost editor — the next publish overwrites it.
'regenerate' names a script that must run before the source is read, so a generated
source file cannot be published stale. It runs only under -Regenerate (it needs a
restored NuGet cache), and the script warns when a page that declares one is published
